claims.claim_text: KV Instant 每個 namespace 每秒一次寫入換 p99 約 1.62 毫秒讀取；Willison 主張預算上限預設觸頂即停機；gVisor 把治理權從單一公司交給 CNCF
claims.evidence: KV Instant also restricts write frequency to one write per namespace per second. | 1.62 ms | I think hard budget caps need to be the default. | thereby preventing Google from having unilateral control over governance decisions
claims.note: Each part is backed by its item's own source; see c02, c04, c19 and c11/c13.

claims.claim_text: Workers KV 的 Instant 模式後端換成 Quicksilver，官方標示 p99 讀取 1.62 毫秒，經典模式 287 毫秒
claims.evidence: KV Instant is powered by Quicksilver v2 ... we've never made Quicksilver available to our customers. | P99 read latency: Instant 1.62 ms, Classic 287 ms
claims.note: The source names it Quicksilver v2. The lede already marks the figures as official/self-reported.

claims.claim_text: 寫入複製到 300 多個節點的中位數 107 毫秒、p99 256 毫秒
claims.evidence: Median 107 ms, P99 256 ms ... Time to replicate to all edge locations (over 300 as of publication)
claims.note: The source says 'edge locations', which the lede renders as 節點.

claims.claim_text: 每個 namespace 每秒只能寫一次，且不支援 metadata；目前是私有 beta
claims.evidence: KV Instant also restricts write frequency to one write per namespace per second. | Metadata is not supported, so `getWithMetadata` calls always return `null` | KV Instant is launching today in private beta
claims.note: The limit is per namespace in the source, not per key.

claims.claim_text: Kolibri：Apache 2.0、總參數 78.1B、啟用約 3.46B 的 MoE，384 位專家每個 token 啟用 6 位，脈絡長度上看 100 萬 tokens，英德雙語
claims.evidence: 78.1B total parameters | 3.46B active parameters / token | 384 total experts with 6 active per token | supports context lengths of up to 1M tokens | used under the Apache 2.0 license terms | Kolibri is an English-German Mixture-of-Experts Transformer
claims.note: 78.1B and 3.46B come from the comparison table; the prose rounds to 78B and 3B.

claims.claim_text: 官方自報 AIME 2025 英文 96.9%、GPQA Diamond 英文 84.3%
claims.evidence: AIME 2025 (English version): 96.9 ... GPQA Diamond (English): 84.3
claims.note: The source shows the scores without a '%' sign. The lede labels them vendor-reported.

claims.claim_text: 並強調訓練與供應鏈都在歐洲
claims.evidence: Our teams built the model in Germany, trained it on infrastructure in Germany and Finland, under European and German law, with no foreign control. | We offer full supply-chain integrity
claims.note: The source does not literally say the supply chain is located in Europe; combined reading is close enough. Low risk.

claims.claim_text: 每個行程映射同一批分頁都需要各自一份頁表項目，每筆 8 bytes，512 個行程映射相同分頁時頁表大小等於資料本身
claims.evidence: Each PTE has 8 bytes. If 512 processes map the same page, they need 512 PTEs: 512 * 8 = 4 KiB. | if you are running 512 processes with identical PTEs, the page tables cost as much as data pages.

claims.claim_text: 文章蒐集 2002 到 2026 年案例；ClickHouse 200 個連線下一般分頁的頁表 6.1 GiB，改用 huge pages 後降到 111 MiB
claims.evidence: At 200 connections, page tables took 6.1 GiB. With huge pages, 200 connections only cost 111 MiB. | (cases from Andrea Arcangeli's 2002 report ... ClickHouse 2026)
claims.note: Units corrected from GB/MB to GiB/MiB after the check.

claims.claim_text: 換算約 56 倍
claims.note: The source states no ratio; 6.1 GiB / 111 MiB is about 56.3. The lede originally said 約 55 倍 without marking it as derived; fixed to 換算約 56 倍.

claims.claim_text: Google 把 gVisor 的名稱、商標與治理捐給 CNCF，申請 9 月 7 日提交、9 月 28 日通過
claims.evidence: Google is donating the gVisor project, including its name and trademarks, to the Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF). | 2026-09-07: Google submitted its CNCF donation application | 2026-09-28: The application was accepted.
claims.note: Governance moves to a maintainers-based model; putting 治理 in the donated list is a fair compression.

claims.claim_text: 動機之一是專案全屬 Google 時，核心維護者會拒絕上游 patch
claims.evidence: We have tried to address this by upstreaming Linux kernel patches that improve its performance, but have been turned down by kernel maintainers due to gVisor being a wholly-owned Google project.
claims.note: The source reports a past event; the lede's 會拒絕 broadens slightly, not a meaning change.

claims.claim_text: 新維護者夥伴包括 Ant Group、Modal 與 Tines，治理轉為以維護者為主的模式
claims.evidence: The following entities have committed to joining gVisor's maintainers for the long haul: Ant Group, Modal, and Tines. | a maintainers-based model

claims.claim_text: 原因包括早年瀏覽器落後 jQuery、MDN 統一之前文件散在各處，以及自己動手比較好玩
claims.evidence: For the longest time, browsers were playing catch-up with the ecosystem on top of them. Libraries like jQuery filled crucial gaps | documentation for the web platform was scattered across blogs, StackOverflow, and sites like CSS Tricks | building things yourself is just more fun

claims.claim_text: 他因為做 PouchDB 學到儲存 API，後來才有能力參與 W3C 標準
claims.evidence: Without the forcing function of a gap in the platform that needed to be filled, I don't know if I would have found the interest or motivation to get to that level of expertise.
claims.note: The source ties PouchDB to his later work on W3C and IndexedDB spec discussions.

claims.claim_text: netip.AddrFrom16(ip.As16()) 要 7.14 ns，原生實作只要 0.88 ns
claims.evidence: AddrTo6/safe 7.137n ± 0% ... AddrTo6/builtin 0.8775n ± 2% (Go 1.27.1) | Today, this pattern is eight times slower than a native method.

claims.claim_text: 先試了 IR 層的取代，因太脆弱而放棄
claims.evidence: It relies on the internal structure of `net/netip.Addr`. It's an ugly hack in the noder ... And it's harder to maintain than adding a `To6()` method.
claims.note: The source never says 'fragile'; 太脆弱 is a reasonable paraphrase. Low risk.

claims.claim_text: 改在 SSA 層補 rewrite rule 並提前 memcombine pass，在 Go 1.26.8 的基準上執行時間縮短 86.34%
claims.note: 86.34% is the source's own benchstat delta against a Go 1.26.8 baseline of 6.55 ns, not computed from 7.14/0.88 (Go 1.27.1 run, ~87.7%). Lede now states the baseline.

claims.claim_text: Willison 主張把「超支就停機」設為預設，理由是 AI coding agent 讓失控服務更容易出現，並提議用明確的選擇退出
claims.evidence: I think hard budget caps need to be the default. | after $X/month, cut this thing off and return errors. These need to be **hard** limits. | Coding agents ... greatly reduce the friction of spinning up code that can do useful things. | Remove the budget cap. My application will not be shut down if I exceed the configured budget limit, and I will be responsible for subsequent charges.

claims.claim_text: AWS 在 2026 年 9 月推出支出上限，Google Cloud 在 7 月推出 Spend Caps
claims.evidence: When you're ready to upgrade to a paid plan, you can set a monthly spend limit for your project ... (AWS announcement dated 16th September) | Google Cloud ... set a monthly financial cap on specific services within a project (launched in July)
claims.note: The source dates AWS's announcement to 16 September; the year is implied by the post date.

claims.claim_text: MoE-CORE 在 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-W4A8 上平均每個輸出 token 38.0 到 44.8 毫秒，對照 vLLM Prefetch 的 1268.9 到 1269.1 毫秒
claims.evidence: MoE-CORE: Coordinated Expert Offloading and Residency for Memory-Constrained MoE Inference | expert weights can exceed limited device memory | On DeepSeek-V4-Flash-W4A8 ... 38.0-44.8 ms ... vLLM Prefetch 1268.9-1269.1 ms
claims.note: The lede notes the numbers are from the paper's own experiments.

claims.claim_text: derive 產生的實作會帶上 #[inline]，層層巢狀的錯誤型別中 Debug 實作被展開造成程式碼膨脹
claims.evidence: Rust's `#[derive(...)]` macro implementations automatically include `#[inline]` hints, which is "implied by example in the reference" ... the compiler may aggressively inline all these functions
claims.note: The source hedges that the inline is implied by the reference's examples; the title's 常常暗含 keeps that hedge.

claims.claim_text: uv 擋掉單一 Debug 實作的 inline，二進位檔可縮小約 160KB
claims.evidence: The uv project identified a single `Debug` implementation whose inlining contributed roughly 160KB to binary size.

claims.claim_text: 做法是寫自訂 proc macro，行為像 derive(Debug)，但標成 inline(never)
claims.evidence: The team created a custom procedural macro mimicking `derive(Debug)` but annotated with `#[inline(never)]`
claims.note: The source credits the macro to the uv team.

claims.claim_text: DoorDash Agent Gateway：資料面 proxy 驗證呼叫者、檢查權限、限流與稽核，控制面 registry 存放 agent、MCP 伺服器與政策
claims.evidence: verifies the caller, checks permissions, applies rate limits, attaches the required credentials, and forwards the request | It can record a structured event for each call ... Security teams can audit access | control plane registry stores configuration data about agents, servers, policies, and tool catalogs
claims.note: The source is ByteByteGo's secondary write-up of DoorDash's system.

claims.claim_text: 200 多個 MCP 伺服器、30 多個 agent 與服務，每週數百萬次工具呼叫，探索與執行分開授權
claims.evidence: more than 200 registered MCP servers, more than 30 agents and services used by thousands of employees, and millions of tool calls each week | A tool appearing in a discovery response doesn't remove the need to authorize its execution.
claims.note: The lede attributes the figures to 文中.
